qa_pairs.question: What SLURM resources are requested for an Ansys Mechanical Shared Memory Parallel (CPU) job according to this script snippet?
qa_pairs.answer: The script requests 32 GB of total memory, one compute node, 8 cores (tasks), and one CPU per task for an Ansys Mechanical Shared Memory Parallel (CPU) job.

qa_pairs.question: Which Ansys software module version is loaded in this Slurm script for an Ansys Mechanical Shared Memory Parallel (CPU) job?
qa_pairs.answer: This script loads the `ansys/2024R1.03` module version, along with `StdEnv/2023`.

qa_pairs.question: What specific environment variable modification is applied for jobs running on the Cedar cluster as indicated in this Ansys Mechanical Shared Memory Parallel (CPU) script?
qa_pairs.answer: When the job runs on the Cedar cluster, the `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` environment variable is set to `$EBROOTGCC/../lib/gcc`.
